a1.text: TutorLoop is the back office for student tutors. It was built by Aariv Patel.
a1.caption: TutorLoop is the back office for student tutors. It was built by Aariv Patel.

a2.text: Lots of students tutor younger kids, and they run it out of a notes app and a Venmo feed. Three things break.
a2.caption: Lots of students tutor younger kids, and they run it out of a notes app and a Venmo feed. Three things break.

a3.text: Money: after a few weeks, nobody remembers who paid. Parents: families want to know if tutoring is working. And proof: volunteer tutoring counts toward NHS service hours, which need a log a sponsor can sign.
a3.caption: Money: after a few weeks, nobody remembers who paid. Parents: families want to know if tutoring is working. And proof: volunteer tutoring counts toward NHS service hours, which need a log a sponsor can sign.

a4.text: Tutoring software exists, but it's built for companies with staff and budgets, not a 16 year old with three students. That's the gap.
a4.caption: Tutoring software exists, but it's built for companies with staff and budgets, not a sixteen-year-old with three students. That's the gap.

a5.text: Here's the live app, brand new. Type one student, the minutes, what you covered, and how it went.
a5.caption: Here's the live app, brand new. Type one student, the minutes, what you covered, and how it went.

a6.text: Save, and TutorLoop has already drafted the parent update and the invoice. That's the whole idea in about thirty seconds.
a6.caption: Save, and TutorLoop has already drafted the parent update and the invoice. That's the whole idea in about thirty seconds.

b1.text: Now load sample data to show a busy month. A bar at the top says the students are made up.
b1.caption: Now load sample data to show a busy month. A bar at the top says the students are made up.

b2.text: One glance shows this month's earnings, 115 dollars still unpaid, and 2.25 of 10 service hours.
b2.caption: One glance shows this month's earnings, $115 still unpaid, and 2.25 of 10 service hours.

b3.text: Ethan's family owes 90 dollars. Remind writes a polite, itemized email with both session dates.
b3.caption: Ethan's family owes $90. Remind writes a polite, itemized email with both session dates.

b4.text: Logging a session takes about ten seconds: student, minutes, topics, a quick note. It previews the amount as you type.
b4.caption: Logging a session takes about ten seconds: student, minutes, topics, a quick note. It previews the amount as you type.

b5.text: Save, and any action can be undone.
b5.caption: Save, and any action can be undone.

c1.text: Parent updates are the part families notice. TutorLoop reads the tutor's own session notes and writes the update: topics, the trend, the latest win, what's next, and the balance.
c1.caption: Parent updates are the part families notice. TutorLoop reads the tutor's own session notes and writes the update: topics, the trend, the latest win, what's next, and the balance.

c2.text: Edit it, then one click opens it in your email.
c2.caption: Edit it, then one click opens it in your email.

c3.text: Unpaid sessions roll into an invoice. At month's end there's one statement per family, or one recap for a sponsor.
c3.caption: Unpaid sessions roll into an invoice. At month's end there's one statement per family, or one recap for a sponsor.

c4.text: Volunteer sessions count toward a goal and export as a CSV or a printable log with a signature line for the NHS sponsor.
c4.caption: Volunteer sessions count toward a goal and export as a CSV or a printable log with a signature line for the NHS sponsor.

c5.text: Free covers three students and the whole product. At the limit, TutorLoop shows the plans and prices Pro in the tutor's own terms: about nine minutes of tutoring a month. Checkout is a demo; no money moves.
c5.caption: Free covers three students and the whole product. At the limit, TutorLoop shows the plans and prices Pro in the tutor's own terms: about nine minutes of tutoring a month. Checkout is a demo; no money moves.

d1.text: Under the hood it's plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No framework, no server, no paid APIs.
d1.caption: Under the hood it's plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No framework, no server, no paid APIs.

d2.text: core dot J S is pure business logic: money in cents, balances, invoices, summaries, and the report engine. It never touches the page, so it runs in Node with unit tests.
d2.caption: core.js is pure business logic: money in cents, balances, invoices, summaries, and the report engine. It never touches the page, so it runs in Node with unit tests.

d3.text: Today's run: 65 unit tests, 11 money property tests, and 66 DOM checks, all passing. A strict content security policy blocks inline scripts, and a service worker makes it work offline.
d3.caption: Today's run: 65 unit tests, 11 money property tests, and 66 DOM checks, all passing. A strict content security policy blocks inline scripts, and a service worker makes it work offline.

d4.text: Parent updates come from an on-device engine. It costs nothing per report, and notes about kids never leave the device.
d4.caption: Parent updates come from an on-device engine. It costs nothing per report, and notes about kids never leave the device.

d5.text: Scaling is cheap by design. Static files on a CDN cost the same for ten tutors or a hundred thousand, and a test runs five thousand sessions under a strict time budget. For Pro sync, the data maps onto Postgres tables with row-level security.
d5.caption: Scaling is cheap by design. Static files on a CDN cost the same for ten tutors or a hundred thousand, and a test runs five thousand sessions under a strict time budget. For Pro sync, the data maps onto Postgres tables with row-level security.

e1.text: The business model is freemium: free for three students, Pro at 4 dollars a month, and Club at 99 dollars a school year, so one N H S sponsor brings a whole chapter.
e1.caption: The business model is freemium: free for three students, Pro at $4 a month, and Club at $99 a school year, so one NHS sponsor brings a whole chapter.

e2.text: N H S has more than 16 thousand chapters. If every one paid for Club, that's a ceiling of about 1.5 million dollars a year. It's a ceiling, not a forecast.
e2.caption: NHS has more than 16,000 chapters. If every one paid for Club, that's a ceiling of about $1.5 million a year. It's a ceiling, not a forecast.

e3.text: Today there are no users or revenue yet. Next is a pilot with student tutors and one N H S sponsor.
e3.caption: Today there are no users or revenue yet. Next is a pilot with student tutors and one NHS sponsor.

e4.text: That's TutorLoop. It's free at aariv dot me slash tutor loop. Thanks for watching.
e4.caption: That's TutorLoop. It's free at aariv.me/Tutorloop. Thanks for watching.
